x0  = 0x00000000

x1  = 0x000000a0   // ra (last jalr return before exit)

x2  = 0x00000000
x3  = 0x00000000
x4  = 0x00000000

x5  = 0xff00ff00   // loaded mask
x6  = 0xffffffff   // -1
x7  = 0x0000007f

x8  = 0x00010040   // base pointer (0x10000 + 64)
x9  = 0x0001ffe0

x10 = 0x00000003   // a0 (final result)
x11 = 0x00000001   // a1 (final result)

x12 = 0x00000000
x13 = 0x00000000
x14 = 0x00000000
x15 = 0x00000000
x16 = 0x00000000
x17 = 0x00000000

x18 = 0x00000000   // loop counter exhausted
x19 = 0x00000000
x20 = 0x00000001
x21 = 0x00000000
x22 = 0x00000000
x23 = 0x00000000
x24 = 0x00000001
x25 = 0x00000000
x26 = 0x00000000
x27 = 0x00000000

x28 = 0x0000001f   // =31 (shift amount)
x29 = 0x00000000
x30 = 0x00000001
x31 = 0x00000000
